apps.name: LINKING
apps.about: A two-player strategy board game of diagonal lines, clashes and breakthroughs. Play the computer, a friend on one phone, or a friend's phone nearby over Bluetooth.
apps.after_install: Open LINKING and play. Please keep it installed for two weeks: Google counts testers before the public release.

apps.name: ContactSync
apps.tagline: The networking app that adds real people in your niche to your contacts.
apps.about: Choose who lands in your phone contacts: people with your tags, buyers or sellers, a state, an age range. They get your number too, always both ways. Android, 18+.

promo.text: Launch bonus: your first month is free, plus 6 more months with this code (first 100 members).
promo.where: After you sign in: Profile > Subscription > Have a code?

apps.after_install: Open ContactSync and sign in with your WhatsApp number. Then claim your bonus: Profile > Subscription > Have a code?

apps.name: Handharbor
apps.about: A free directory of digital project brokers we check by hand: their face, their intro video, their freelance profiles and their ID on a video call, rechecked every 30 days. Message one, or hire them on their Upwork, Fiverr or LinkedIn. Handharbor never handles project money.
apps.after_install: Open Handharbor and browse the register. To list yourself, tap Account, then Get verified.

apps.name: Odd One Out
apps.tagline: Three match. One doesn't. Spot it.
apps.about: A picture puzzle game: four pictures, three share something, tap the odd one out. 30 levels, stars to earn, daily goals. No timer, no account.
apps.after_install: Open Odd One Out and play the first level. No sign-up needed.
